description:
Let AI agents highlight and annotate any webpage — end-to-end encrypted, no accounts needed.

**Tools:**
- `annotate_page` — highlight or comment on text at any URL
- `get_annotations` — retrieve all annotations on a page
- `share_page` — generate a shareable link (anyone views annotations live on the original page)
- `remove_annotation` — delete an annotation by ID

**Privacy:** Annotations are AES-256-GCM encrypted client-side. The key lives in the URL fragment — the server only ever stores ciphertext.

**Works with:** Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and any MCP-compatible agent.

**No API keys. No sign-up. Zero tracking.**

Part of [Pooch PDF](https://poochpdf.com) — a Chrome extension for web annotation with collaborative sharing.
